summary.text: Chris Anderson is a nonpartisan candidate for Nebraska State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent John Fredrickson.
A retired U.S. Air Force colonel and former defense-industry business development executive, Anderson said in a Ballotpedia survey that property tax relief is his top issue.

paragraphs.text: Chris Anderson was born in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses, and he holds a bachelor's degree in economics and an MBA in marketing from Indiana University.
He also graduated from the U.S. Air Force Weapons School.

Anderson said he served 31 years in the Air Force on active duty and in the Reserves, with roles that included acquisitions officer, combat aviator and chief of nuclear operations at U.S. Strategic Command, and that he retired as a colonel in 2025.
He also reported about 15 years in defense-industry marketing and sales at Rockwell Collins and BAE Systems, most recently as senior director of business development at BAE Systems.
In the May 12, 2026 primary for District 20, Anderson advanced with 25.2 percent of the vote; Fredrickson received 59.9 percent.
Anderson called property tax relief the top issue in the district and said he would prioritize mental health policy, including expanding the youth mental health workforce.
He also said he would continue funding law enforcement while looking for efficiencies through technology.
